title: Marked GUE-corners process in doubly periodic dimer models
summary: We study a family of periodically weighted Aztec diamond dimer models near their turning points. We establish that, asymptotically, as $N\rightarrow\infty$, their fluctuations there, scaled by $\sqrt{N}$, are described by a marked GUE-corners process. This limiting point process is constructed by assigning a Bernoulli mark independently to each particle in a realization of the GUE-corners process.
